fields.creator: Frozen static identity + Root activation
fields.trusted_source: Root activation binding + current fixed source digests + original receipt
fields.read_rule: Exact current namespace and frozen-source match

fields.creator: Original Root bootstrap
fields.read_rule: All original records agree; historical audit preserves old boot

fields.creator: Original admitted scheduler once
fields.read_rule: Finite values and original1800/1740 relations; no defaults

fields.creator: Original init_counter + prepaid reserve protocol
fields.mutable: Only active original core; none in terminal API
fields.trusted_source: Bound counter inode/magic/cap + COMMITTED intent + full journal pairs
fields.read_rule: Shared counter lock, contiguous positive ranges ending at R

fields.creator: Original reservation core
fields.mutable: Original append protocol while active; terminal no writes
fields.read_rule: Stream bound32MiB/32768-byte lines,2*cap+1 iterations; no construction
fields.missing: UNRESOLVED, including initializedR0 with absent journal

fields.creator: Original stop_tree/request_stop
fields.trusted_source: Root CLOSED or original typed STOP record
fields.read_rule: Presence + proper metadata/original boot, never infer solely from group empty

fields.creator: Original PF phase transaction writer
fields.mutable: Original active sequence only; terminal no changes
fields.trusted_source: Private phase, public checkpoint, initialization hash
fields.read_rule: SH counter then SH phase; exact phase/sequence/digest equality

fields.creator: Direct Root coordinator waitpid + original stopper
fields.trusted_source: waitpid child/owner/raw status + original role bindings and current same-boot live-role observation
fields.read_rule: Sealing waits original stopper closure first; historical witness never grants current seal

fields.creator: Original MR abort/close path when invoked
fields.read_rule: Absence yields UNKNOWN; preserve existing value

fields.creator: Original sealer with added readonly preconditions
fields.mutable: New artifact/result only, original evidence never rewritten
fields.trusted_source: Existing native manifest/ZIP streams or actual SEAL_ERROR record
fields.read_rule: Complete only after actual member/current-evidence verification; no ready==completed shortcut

snapshot_decision: Reuse originals/journal. No new runtime snapshot or budget checkpoint. Separate sealer writes a PRE_NATIVE_ARCHIVE_READ_ONLY_REVIEW receipt.
trust_assumptions: Inherited trusted kernel/Root launcher/frozen reservation writers and no concurrent privileged update; journal structure is checked, no new cryptographic journal authenticity claim.
readonly_semantics: No application/ledger/lifecycle writes; descriptor locks and observation objects are transient. Filesystem-managed read metadata is not a runtime authority.
resource_scope: Readonly bounded administrative IO, no semantic visit debit and no new runtime deadline/window
